description: This file defines a Kotlin class `CameraHandler` responsible for managing camera operations such as listing devices, taking snapshots, and recording clips within an Android application. It includes methods for handling camera interactions, logging, and error handling, tailored for use with coroutines and JSON serialization.

classes.name: CameraHandler
classes.description: A class managing camera device listing, photo snapping, and video clipping in an Android app, with logging and error handling, supporting coroutine-based asynchronous operations.

methods.name: handleList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available camera devices and returns them as a JSON payload.

methods.name: handleSnap
methods.description: Captures a photo using the camera and returns the payload JSON, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: handleClip
methods.description: Records a video clip, encodes it in base64, and returns the result, including payload size validation, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: parseIncludeAudio
methods.description: Parses the 'includeAudio' parameter from JSON input to determine if audio should be included in the clip.
